newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Rabo enters Belgian mortgage market.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Rabo enters Belgian mortgage market.

text.p: Cooperative Rabobank Nederland BA, the Netherlands' biggest mortgage provider, said on Thursday it had extended its mortgage lending activities across the border into Belgium on a modest scale.
"This is a modest initiative, limited to eight independently operating branches which already maintain extensive links with Belgian clients," Rabobank spokesman Jan Dost said.
He said eight Rabobank branches in the southern Netherlands had been registered in Belgium as "housing credit" providers.
Dost said the independently operating branches managed significant amounts of Belgian capital and as such the Belgian mortgage market was a logical place for them to lend out.
"This should certainly not be viewed as a strategic move aimed at creating a second home market in Belgium," he said.
